primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: NUM24:17は星・笏の託宣で「イエス」を名指さない。後代のキリスト教的メシア解釈を、民数記の直接登場人物として採用しない。
